Author: azazev
Name: SimBridge
Description: An experimental Dalamud compatibility plugin connecting AnoMech simulations with BossMod Reborn encounter modules. Requires both plugins.
Punchline: Experimental AnoMech encounter activation for BossmodReborn.
Changelog:
New AnoMech simulations
- The Weapon's Refrain (Ultimate): Ultimate Predation and Ultimate Suppression.
- The Unending Coil of Bahamut (Ultimate): P5 Exaflares.

SimBridge now supports 11 simulations. All three additions use BossMod Reborn's native guidance.
